source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
**MONSTER** and **VEHICLE** units follow extra rules, covering:

- [moving those models](vsdata:core-rule/moving-monsters-and-vehicles)
- measuring from **[FRAME](vsdata:core-rule/frame)** models
- [shooting at them while they are engaged](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-at-engaged-monsters-and-vehicles)
